'''Rel Bentin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] failed to comprehend the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species']] culture by studying their art, he [[Bombardment of Oben|bombarded]] the Kaleesh [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Hyperspace" /> [[Oben]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> destroying the [[Bentilais san Sk'ar's headquarters|headquarters]] of the Kaleesh [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]], [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]]. Afterward, Bentin encountered a surrendering Sk'ar in his base, and was intimidated by the warlord's size, bringing the Kaleesh to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Palpatine then allowed Sk'ar to serve the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Hyperspace" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rel Bentin was introduced in the [[2007]] article ''[[Aliens in the Empire]]'', written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] for the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] website.<ref name="Hyperspace" />
